verdict.rationale: Kintsugi docs explicitly define credit notes as refund/return/adjustment records against original sales, with a dedicated API guide for handling refund transactions, implying these flow into liability and filings via the same transaction-sync pipeline used for nexus/filing determination. Missing for 10: explicit documentation showing negative amounts reducing liability totals or appearing in filing reports, and independent/hands-on confirmation that no manual journal adjustments are needed.
